en.title: Drops of the Galaxy and the Footprints of a Nameless Cat
en.premise: I am an apprentice cartographer, traveling in search of the signposts of lost stars. One day, as if guided by a nameless silver cat, I come into possession of a fragment of an ancient star chart. The map points toward a place where the memories of forgotten stars lie sleeping. As I encounter the unique customs and wondrous cuisines of various lands, I begin to piece together the fragments of the world.

zh.title: 银河之滴与无名猫之足迹
zh.premise: 我是一名见习制图师，在寻找失落星辰的指引之路上旅行。某一天，仿佛受到一只无名银猫的引导，我得到了一块刻有古老星图的碎片。那张地图所指向的地方，是沉睡着被遗忘星辰记忆之所。在体验各地风俗与奇妙料理的同时，我正一点点拼凑起世界的碎片。
